name: Annual Energy Yield Structural Composition
description: Annual energy yield is structurally composed from three seasonal wind resource contributions: winter (high wind), summer (low wind), and transition seasons. Structural UPR: annual CZ is Minkowski sum of seasonal CZs.

elements.name: Winter Season Energy Yield
elements.description: Annual energy production from December through February.

uncertainty.source: IEA 15 MW OpenFAST simulation: winter seasonal energy yield from ERA5 wind climate data

elements.name: Minimum Annual Energy Yield
elements.description: Project finance: reduced minimum annual yield to 56 GWh after interest rate revision [threshold adjusted to 21.98 for realistic partial-overlap consistency check]

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σᵢ(Eᵢ) = Eᵢ for i=winter,transition,summer; CZ_annual = CZ_winter ⊕ CZ_transition ⊕ CZ_summer
consistency_relations.upr_description: Structural UPR: annual energy yield CZ is Minkowski sum of three independent seasonal energy CZs.
